tei:p.tei:seg: We thank Thee for Thou art the Lord our God and the God of our fathers for ever and ever. The Rock of our life, the Shield of our salvation art Thou from generation to generation. We thank Thee and tell of Thy fame for our life that is delivered in Thy hand and for our souls that are entrusted to Thee and for Thy miracles that are daily with us and for Thy wonders and benefits at all times, evening, morning and noon. O Thou who art good for Thy mercies never end, O Thou who showest mercy for Thy kindnesses never cease, ever have we trusted in Thee.
For all of them may Thy Name, O our King, be continually blessed and exalted for ever and ever.
And inscribe for a good life all the children of Thy Covenant.

And all the living thank Thee, Selah, and praise Thy Name in truth, O God of our salvation and of our aid, Selah! Blessed art Thou, O Lord, All-benevolent, whose name is goodness and unto whom it is becoming to give thanks.
